scope_comment: Scoped to high-stakes paths only. Globs include not-yet-existing paths (prompts, state-rules, anthropic-client-byok) so this config activates when those modules land. The Stryker validator will warn 'Unknown stryker config option' for the *_comment keys — this is intentional documentation; see Stryker's own hint in that warning ('Did you only write this property as a comment?').
thresholds_comment: thresholds.break is set ~5 points below the observed baseline (26.90% on 2026-05-20) to give CI headroom for noise. Ratchet plan: raise by 5 points once the suite stays above current break + 5 across several PRs and nightly runs. See docs/testing.md.
tsconfig_comment: tsconfigFile points at tsconfig.stryker.json (not the project tsconfig.json) so Stryker's TS checker only compiles the files we mutate plus their dependencies — avoids pre-existing type errors in unrelated UI files blocking the dry-run compile.
